phase_contract.mechanical_assumption: Hall=0; increasing counts; upward motion begins after zero; no pi switching label
phase_contract.availability_assumption: Encoder timestamp + 20 ms guard; assumes work queue publication latency <=20 ms. Not a measured upper bound; offline research only.
phase_contract.frozen_contract_override: PACLD explicitly inherits PA-HBD Hall observation override; frozen tables/splits/QC unchanged.
phase_contract.threshold_scope: Fixed sensor QC: 0.15 rad reference innovation, 50 ms gap, 500 ms recovery, 20 Hz count-rate sanity ceiling; not tuned by model error or absolute calibration.

normalization: fixed physical unit scales; no data fit
execution_contract: Explicit steps only; smoke bounded to 1-3 updates. No automatic formal launch.

training.selection: FULL state loss: windows mean within flight/horizon, horizons equal within flight, flights equal
training.sampling: FlightBalancedSampler: shuffled flights, shuffled horizons per flight, uniform window

loss.full_reduction: EKF family and gyro equal, events equal within family
loss.macro_reduction: sources equal, valid pairs equal within source
